narrative.intro: Acquisition Logistics obligated $609M in FY2026 to date across 5 awards. Acquisition Logistics averaged $122M per award. Acquisition Logistics obligations are up 131.5% year over year. Acquisition Logistics received the bulk of FY2026 to date obligations from the Department of Homeland Security, which obligated $598M. Acquisition Logistics also recorded $10.8M in obligations from the Department of Defense. Acquisition Logistics shows a clear market focus: Process, Physical Distribution, and Logistics Consulting Services accounted for $609M of obligations, while Other Support Activities for Water Transportation accounted for $311K. These totals are partial and reflect fiscal year to date contract obligations and selected award-value tables where noted.

sections.heading: Who bought the most from Acquisition Logistics in FY2026 to date?
sections.body: The Department of Homeland Security obligated $598M from Acquisition Logistics in FY2026 to date. The Department of Defense obligated $10.8M. These two agencies account for the top buying activity listed for the period.
